title: Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey, United States, 2024
design: cross-sectional, web-based survey using a stratified random sample from the probability-based KnowledgePanel
weighting: KnowledgePanel selection probability and post-stratification to CPS/ACS benchmarks for age by gender, race/ethnicity, education, children, region, metro status, homeownership, family income/FPL, family composition, primary language, and internet access by age
response_rate_note: ICPSR describes the cumulative response rate as roughly 3–4% each round
catalog_status: ICPSR search lists the study as curated, partially restricted, and with simple-crosstab/online-analysis availability; data-file access in the current workspace remains unauthenticated
evidence_boundary: Catalog metadata verifies study identity, design, universe, weighting, and topic coverage. It does not verify that the current workspace can retrieve the respondent file, that the mapped route fields are present in the public-use file, or that any route/outcome cross-tab has been computed.
